summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Telegram Intel Bot PHASE 6 Delivery Layer. Most backend APIs working correctly, frontend displays properly, but one API has database schema issue.

critical_bugs.issue: E11000 duplicate key error - telegramUserId unique constraint conflict when creating pending connections
critical_bugs.impact: Blocks new user Telegram bot connections
critical_bugs.details: Schema requires telegramUserId to be unique but allows null values during pending state, causing constraint violations

design_issues.issue: Button correctly disabled when bot not configured
design_issues.notes: This is expected behavior since TG_BOT_TOKEN not set

passed_tests: GET /api/telegram-intel/bot/status - returns correct bot.configured=false and connection status
GET /api/admin/telegram-intel/bot/stats - returns bot and connection statistics
Frontend /telegram page loads with Leaderboard interface
Frontend /telegram/alerts page loads with TelegramBotConnect component
TelegramBotConnect component displays properly in Russian
Button states correctly reflect bot configuration status
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix database schema issue in tg_bot_connections.model.ts - telegramUserId field should be sparse and not required for initial connection records. The unique constraint should only apply when telegramUserId is not null.
